answer: Admission auction: every work slot goes to the highest bidder, and the winning bid burns. A comet that flashes past once is cheap to fake, but a voyage of a thousand clones means a thousand burned bids. Each clone bids 5 units for a slot, so 1,000 clones burn 5,000 units for slots worth only 200 units of work. A zephyr of fake identities blows its own money away. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns from real work.
